dominant_strengths: Clear typography hierarchy with readable fonts and consistent sizing across command labels
Logical information architecture grouping related commands into semantic categories
High behavioral utility delivering exactly what users need - keyboard shortcuts at a glance
dominant_weaknesses: Harsh low-contrast color scheme strains eyes with gray text on dark backgrounds
Visually monotonous grid lacks any visual interest or memorable design elements
Zero innovation - follows most generic possible approach to displaying shortcuts
fix_priorities: Increase contrast ratios to meet accessibility standards while maintaining dark theme
Add subtle color coding to differentiate command categories and improve scannability
Introduce visual hierarchy through spacing, dividers, or background treatments
Consider iconography or visual metaphors to make commands more memorable
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral design (functional organization) undermined by poor visceral appeal (harsh aesthetics) and minimal reflective value (forgettable experience).
rationale.intent_fit: Successfully delivers utility through clear command organization but fails to make the reference tool pleasant or memorable to use.
